slides.title: Google Business Profile checklist
body: 7 things to fix this week so local customers can actually find you.

slides.title: Verify your profile
body: Unverified profiles rarely show up in Maps. Request your code from the Business Profile dashboard.

slides.title: Pick the exact category
body: "House cleaning service" beats "Cleaning service." Your primary category is one of the biggest ranking factors.

slides.title: List every service
body: One line each: standard clean, deep clean, move-out, recurring. Customers search for the specific job.

slides.title: Service area + real hours
body: • Set hours you actually answer the phone

slides.title: Photos + reviews
body: • Add photos of real jobs every month
• Ask every customer for a review within 24 hours

slides.title: Want your score?
body: Free 15-point visibility audit. 4 minutes. Link in bio.
